newsitem.title: USA: U.S. March equity options volume up 16 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: U.S. March equity options volume up 16 pct yr/yr.

text.p: U.S. equity options volume in March totalled 18,876,183 contracts, up 16 percent from 16,270,170 in March 1996, the Options Industry Council said Thursday.
The council said first quarter volume rose 19 percent to 60,681,554 contracts, compared with 50,924,497 contracts in the first quarter of 1996.
Average daily volume in March was 943,809 contracts, the industry group said.
